name: Country Village Plaza
summary: Country Village Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center on Long Pond Road in Rochester, serving the western suburbs with convenient daily shopping and services. Operating from 10 AM to 9 PM daily, the plaza maintains a strong 4.4-star rating from the local community.
demographics: Country Village Plaza serves the western Rochester suburban market, primarily attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the Long Pond Road corridor. The trade area includes a mix of homeowners and renters with household incomes ranging from $45,000 to $85,000, skewing toward the 30-55 age demographic. Shoppers typically visit for convenience-oriented needs and everyday services, with strong weekday traffic from nearby residential neighborhoods and office parks.
description: Country Village Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 1100 Long Pond Road in Rochester, New York, serving the western suburbs of the Greater Rochester area. Managed by Markiv Enterprises, this accessible plaza has established itself as a reliable destination for everyday shopping and services in the community. The center operates daily from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM, providing convenient hours for working families and professionals in the area. With a solid 4.4-star rating from over 250 Google reviews, Country Village Plaza has earned a reputation for meeting the daily needs of local residents. The plaza's location along the busy Long Pond Road corridor ensures excellent visibility and easy access for shoppers throughout western Rochester.
